verdict.rationale: Built-in screen readers and accessibility tools are a fair question for a desktop OS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions VoiceOver, a screen reader, or accessibility settings. The nearest items are Siri voice customization and hidutil key remapping, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use built-in screen readers and accessibility tools to get started with the OS
